name: Container Yard
instructions: omr/instructions/42062-1-1.pdf (book 1 builds the truck and its semi-trailer, steps 1-28 of bags 1-2, the two containers, steps 24-27, and the reach stacker, bag 3 steps 1-113; page 85 shows every function); omr/instructions/42062-1-2.pdf builds the alternate model

functions.does: The black knob on the truck's cab roof steers the front wheels: its shaft runs down through the cab and a universal joint to an arm that swings the two steering knuckles.
functions.source: book: page 85 (the top right picture: the arrow on the roof knob and the truck turning)

functions.does: The semi-trailer turns on its coupling behind the cab as the truck steers.
functions.source: book: bag 2 step 28 and page 85 (the truck and trailer)

functions.does: The truck's and the trailer's wheels roll freely.
Twist locks at the trailer's corners turn to hold a container down on the trailer.
functions.source: book: bag 2 step 20 (the yellow arrows on the locks); that long beams under the trailer link the locks so they turn together is inferred from the model
functions.note: unsure how the locks are meant to be worked: by hand one by one, or linked

functions.does: The gear at the reach stacker's back end, the lower of two, steers its rear wheels: an axle runs forward to a link that swings the two rear steering knuckles.
functions.source: book: page 85 (the middle right picture: the arrow at the back and the reach stacker turning)

functions.does: The upper gear at the reach stacker's back end raises and lowers the boom: a worm on its axle turns a 20 tooth gear, whose crank arm and links push the boom up about its pivot.
functions.source: book: page 85 (the bottom left picture: the arrow at the back and the boom rising); bag 3 step 87 (the inset shows the boom raised)

functions.does: The knob beside the boom's base extends and retracts the boom: axles linked by angle connectors run up the boom to the rack under its inner section (how they drive it is read from the model and unsure).
functions.source: book: page 85 (the bottom middle picture: the arrow at the boom's base, the double arrow along the boom), bag 3 steps 72-84 (the boom and its rack)

functions.does: The spreader turns on the boom's tip to line up with a container.
functions.source: book: page 85 (the bottom right picture: the curved arrow over the spreader)

functions.does: Turning the axle at the spreader's end swings its claws in to grip a container's top or out to let it go.
functions.source: book: bag 3 steps 104 and 110 (the yellow arrows), page 85 (the bottom right picture: the small arrows at the claws)
functions.note: which parts are the claws is read from the model (the handlergrabberclaw submodel); unsure which axle end the book means to be turned

functions.does: The reach stacker's four wheels roll freely.
